basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Project Executive Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) (भारतीय प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान इंदौर) is filling 1 post of Project Executive – Global Engagement in its International Relations Office. The post is on a contractual basis, initially for 01 year, and the consolidated salary is ₹80,000/- to ₹92,000/- per month. Indian nationals with a Master's Degree in any discipline and 6 years of experience in international relations/affairs can apply through the online application link until 10 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Apply through the application link given in the notice (an online form). The application deadline is 10 November 2026. The notice does not describe any other application steps and does not list documents to attach. The application link is in the Important Links table below.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Indore
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Indore is an institute at Simrol, Khandwa Road, Indore - 453 552, Madhya Pradesh. This post is in the institute's International Relations Office, which handles global engagement, international collaborations, MoUs with foreign universities and international mobility programmes.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. Under the notice, the post is filled on a contractual basis. Experience in handling international affairs, legal matters, Research and Development activities etc. Having experience working in Centrally Funded Technical Institutes/Central Govt./Autonomous Bodies/PSUs etc. The notice lists technical, functional and soft skills under one point: exposure of Academics, Research and Innovation in Higher Education and Global Engagements/Network. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for calculating age, and it does not mention any age relaxation. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. rows.details: PhD in / Engineering/ Sciences/Management/Law/IPR or any relevant disciplinary or interdisciplinary areas/specialized field as per the need of the Institute
6 years of experience in international relations/affairs, out of which at least 3 years should be at the supervisory level or equivalent

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary will be from ₹80,000/- to ₹92,000/- per month (Consolidated). The exact amount depends on the candidate's qualifications and experience. The appointment is first made for 01 year. It may be extended based on performance after a review. The place of posting is printed as "IIT Indore / Any other".

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Project Executive – Global Engagement Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these duties under "Nature of Duties": Handling and operation of the latest electrical / IT equipment and digital technologies for official purposes. Managing global engagement activities and coordination with international institutions/universities. Data collection, data mining, and analysis related to international collaborations and global outreach. Managing and updating the organization's official website and social media platforms. Organizing and conducting video conferencing on various platforms (Zoom, MS Teams, Webex, etc.). Scheduling, coordinating, and professionally attending international meetings and delegations. Drafting and submitting action taken reports and official replies to the Ministry and other government bodies. Preparing professional presentations (PPTs), reports, and briefing materials for meetings and conferences. Processing and coordinating International MoUs/Agreements with foreign universities and institutions. Facilitating bilateral research collaborations and academic partnerships. Coordinating international mobility programs (students, faculty, and staff). Supporting academic and research exchange initiatives and related documentation. Maintaining records, documentation, and compliance related to international engagements.
